_comment: Baseline-only runs: dx+xf view config (the non-logsig comparison model, 'F-style' elsewhere in this repo) with run_modes=baseline (random-init classifier, no pretrained weights loaded — isolates how much pretraining/domain-transfer itself is worth). Covers HAR70plus→HARTH (mirrors experiments_har70plus_harth.json) and the FD-A/B/C/D hub-and-spoke cross-domain pairs (mirrors experiments_fd_crossdomain.json). Requires the run_finetune.py fix that makes 'finetune' honor --run_modes exclusion (previously it always ran regardless of run_modes) — without that fix, run_modes=baseline would still also execute a full finetune run whenever a pretrain checkpoint exists. Cheap epoch budget (epochs_pretrain=2, epochs_finetune=10): the pretrain step still runs (run_experiments.py always pairs pretrain+finetune, and baseline mode never reads that checkpoint), but at 2 epochs it costs ~10-20s per seed and is effectively free — do not raise epochs_pretrain here without first adding a way to skip the pretrain step, or GPU time gets spent on a checkpoint nothing reads. encoder_type omitted (defaults to transformer) and interaction_type omitted (defaults to attention), matching the existing dx+xf 'F-style' baseline blocks' convention of not overriding these for the non-logsig model. Run with: python scripts/run_experiments.py experiment_configs/experiments_baselines.json --gpus 6,7,8

experiments.name: HAR70plus→HARTH (dx+xf): baseline only (random init, no pretrained weights)
FD-A→{FD-B,FD-C,FD-D} (dx+xf): baseline only (random init, no pretrained weights)
FD-B→{FD-A,FD-C,FD-D} (dx+xf): baseline only (random init, no pretrained weights)
FD-C→{FD-A,FD-B,FD-D} (dx+xf): baseline only (random init, no pretrained weights)
FD-D→{FD-A,FD-B,FD-C} (dx+xf): baseline only (random init, no pretrained weights)
